"""Order pricing rules."""

TAX_RATE = 0.0
PROMO_CODE = "SAVE10"


def compute_total(subtotal_cents: int, tax_rate: float | None = None) -> int:
    """Return the total in cents, tax applied on top of the subtotal."""
    rate = TAX_RATE if tax_rate is None else tax_rate
    return subtotal_cents + round(subtotal_cents * rate)

"""Outbound webhook delivery with token rotation and audit logging."""

from auth.tokens import refresh_token


def handle_refresh(user_id: str, reason: str = "scheduled") -> str:
    """Rotate the token for an expiring integration session (audited)."""
    token = refresh_token(user_id)
    _audit(user_id, reason)
    return token


def _audit(user_id: str, reason: str) -> None:
    """Append an audit line (fixture: stdout)."""
    print(f"audit: rotate user={user_id} reason={reason}")

ops.content:
"""Account deletion workflow (independent of authentication)."""

from users.models import Status, User
from users.repository import UserRepository


def schedule_deletion(users: UserRepository, user_id: str, grace_days: int = 30) -> bool:
    """Suspend an account scheduled for deletion; return whether it existed."""
    user = users.get(user_id)
    if user is None:
        return False
    user.status = Status.SUSPENDED
    users.save(user)
    return True
